blocks.text: 6cyclemind marked 25 years in the music industry with an anniversary concert at Eton Centris in Quezon City, bringing longtime fans together for a night of OPM classics, surprise guests, and new music. Despite the intermittent rain throughout the evening, fans remained energized at the band’s anniversary celebration. Opening acts CLNO and Hey June! warmed up the crowd with ‘Magsasaya.’ The band then followed a setlist of fan favorites, including ‘Prinsesa,’ ‘Biglaan,’ ‘I,’ ‘Kasalanan,’ and ‘Trip.’ The concert’s Karaoke Segment added several familiar voices to the stage.
